year.label: 2023 Stock Car Pro Series Toyota Corolla

records.real_world_identity_notes: This is the Toyota Corolla-bodied entry in the 2023 Brazilian Stock Car Pro Series, a category-only race car using the series common purpose-built chassis and platform components. It is not a road Toyota Corolla or Corolla GR-S. The CBA Toyota annex identifies the Stock Car Toyota Corolla construction for the 2023 championship; the common platform and technical regulations establish the shared transmission hardware.
records.confidence_basis: The official CBA 2023 download index names the exact technical-regulation and Toyota-annex document set. The official AMS2 announcement independently identifies the 2023 Toyota Corolla implementation, but is not used as proof of real-car controls.

records.specification_basis: Article 13.2's X-TRAC 396B023 gear-pair table assigns six forward gears. Article 13.2 explicitly permits a semi-automatic paddle-shift actuation system. This supports the project's semi-automatic category, but does not establish internal dog-ring versus synchromesh construction. The regulation requires the semi-automatic paddle-shift actuation system.
